compatibility.rgb_decode: imageio ffmpeg RGB8, divided by 255 as float32
compatibility.psnr: TeaCache RGB all-channel per-frame MSE; values with MSE < 1e-10 are capped at 100 dB
compatibility.ssim: TeaCache RGB channel mean; 11x11 Gaussian window, sigma=1.5, valid crop, K1=0.01, K2=0.03
compatibility.lpips: TeaCache LPIPS AlexNet spatial map mean; package 0.1.4 and model version 0.1 are explicit
compatibility.aggregation: frame mean per video, then equal-weight mean across videos

intentional_fixes: Do not average equal-weight batch means; the final short batch therefore cannot be overweighted.
Reject frame-count or spatial-shape mismatches instead of resizing, cropping, or truncating.
Sort and validate input pairs deterministically and save per-frame and per-video records.
